test_construction_allows_duplicate_label: test creating a pandas Series or DataFrame and verifying the allows_duplicate_labels flag defaults to True
test_set_flags_allows_duplicate_labels: test setting allows_duplicate_labels=False on a pandas Series or DataFrame without duplicate labels
test_preserve_allows_duplicate_labels_bi: test that binary operations like add and sub preserve the allows_duplicate_labels flag on Series and DataFrame
test_preserve_allows_duplicate_labels_co: test that pd.concat preserves allows_duplicate_labels=False across Series and DataFrame combinations
test_preserve_allows_duplicate_labels_me: test that pd.merge preserves allows_duplicate_labels based on the flags of the left and right inputs
test_duplicate_label_error_raises: test that DuplicateLabelError is raised when setting allows_duplicate_labels=False on data with duplicate labels
test_getitem_raises_duplicate_label_erro: test that DuplicateLabelError is raised when indexing with duplicate labels on a DataFrame with allows_duplicate_labels=False
test_concat_raises_duplicate_label_error: test that pd.concat raises DuplicateLabelError when combining objects with allows_duplicate_labels=False and duplicate labels
test_merge_raises_duplicate_label_error: test that pd.merge raises DuplicateLabelError when merging on duplicate index labels with allows_duplicate_labels=False
test_format_duplicate_labels_message: test that Index._format_duplicate_message returns a DataFrame mapping duplicate labels to their positions
